note: br-dim.7: the merged round-complete + highlights screen. video = the replay's share of the whole screen area, by aspect band (width/height, first band whose maxAspect holds); the owner's rule is 0.50 to 0.67. stack = where the video sits: 'left' (under the heading, full height; everything else in a column on its right) or 'top' (full width; everything else below). The other region is searched for the largest scale that fits: stacked (list, join, buttons) first, then list beside join+buttons; the list never truncates (denser cells instead).
